title: SG-5.5.2 Update BootScene tests for sceneSpec mock and constructor arity
summary: BootScene tests mock runtime/content with sceneSpec and type-check cleanly
description: Context: BootScene.create now calls buildScene(..., sceneSpec) and createPhaserEffectContext(scene, resolveKey), but some bootScene*.test.ts files mock '../src/runtime/content' without sceneSpec and call the effect context factory with one argument. Desired behavior: every bootScene*.test.ts mock includes sceneSpec and passes the right arguments. Expected result: the tests pass and have no type errors. Why: keeps the thin-wrapper BootScene refactor covered by green, type-safe tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given bootSceneFallback.test.ts and bootScenePreload.test.ts, When they mock '../src/runtime/content', Then the mock exposes scene, manifest and sceneSpec
Given bootSceneEffects.test.ts, When it calls createPhaserEffectContext, Then it passes the scene and a resolveKey function and tsc reports no arity error
Given the bootScene*.test.ts files, When they run under vitest, Then all pass

in_scope: type-only fixes in BootScene.ts, effectContext.ts, content.ts

technical_constraints: Vitest and phaser mocked; no browser
